title: Insaaf Kaun Karega
desc: Jageera abandons his wife and son Vikram to join a life of crime. Years later, when Vikram, now a police officer, sets out to put an end to Jageera's activities, he swears to kill him.

title: Kal Aaj Aur Kal
desc: When Rajesh comes back to India, he is urged to marry for the sake of an old promise. He is in a dilemma as he is in love with Mona.

title: Bawarchi
desc: Desperate for a cook, the disgruntled Sharmas are relieved when a multi-talented man, Raghu, takes up the job. However, when all seems well, the family jewels disappear and so does Raghu.

title: Insaf Ki Pukar
desc: Police Inspector Imaandaar, Dhani Lal, and Sohan Lal falsely accuse Jagannath, leading to his arrest. Years later, Jagannath's son Ajay seeks revenge for the injustice.

title: Shehzada
desc: Bantu, despised by his father Valmiki, discovers his true parents, the Jindals, and strives to win their affection while protecting them from threats.

title: Abhinetri
desc: Shekhar, a young scientist, falls in love with Anjana, a dancer, and marries her. Differences separate the couple but when Shekhar's mother visits, they are forced to unite again.

title: Parivar (1968)
desc: Gopal, a medical student, marries Meena and starts a family. Their peaceful life is disrupted by tragedy as their daughter dies and Gopal is accused of murder.

title: Bulundi
desc: Caught between politics and crime, a powerful boss fights betrayal and loyalty tests. Friendship turns to rivalry in a violent struggle for justice and control in this gripping action drama.

title: Dost
desc: Maanav helps his friend Gopichand, a former thief, turn his life around with a corporate job, but mysterious circumstances pull them back into trouble when Maanav disappears.

title: Caravan
desc: When Sunita's husband tries to kill her, she escapes and tries to reach a friend in Bangalore. Penniless, she unwillingly joins a travelling gypsy caravan and falls in love with the driver Mohan.

title: Satyakam
desc: The story of Satyapriya Archarya, an Engineering student, is stubborn and principled.

title: Kundan
desc: Shamsher is funded by criminal activities but never gets arrested. But, when Superintendent of Police, Kundan apprehends him, he concocts a devious plan to remain the uncrowned king of the underworld.

title: Shagird
desc: Professor Brij, who is sworn to bachelorhood, mentors Ramesh, who wants to be just like him. However, when the professor falls for Poonam, he faces a dilemma.

title: Phir Teri Kahani Yaad Aye
desc: Rahul Falls In Love With Pooja Who Is Mentally Unstable But She Is Sent To An Asylum Where She Dies In A Fire. Her Memories Keep Haunting Him As He Is Unable To Get Over Her.

title: Zubeidaa
desc: Zubeidaa, an ambitious Muslim actress, marries a Sikh prince as his second wife. Her troubled marriage, personal struggles, and inner conflicts lead to a tragic decision with fatal consequences.
